name: My Pleasure: Holiday Special
source:
MC and some of our heroines received an anonymous invite to a mysterious event. They all get the feeling that there's some kind of catch or prank involved, but they accept the invite nonetheless, hoping for some fun. However, something appears to be wrong from the very beginning, and the evening could end up being completely different from what our heroes expected...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/my-pleasure-43382509]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
MC和我们的一些女主角收到了匿名邀请参加一个神秘的活动。他们都觉得其中有某种陷阱或恶作剧，但他们还是接受了邀请，希望能从中得到一些乐趣。然而，事情从一开始就似乎出了问题，晚上的结局可能与我们的英雄所期望的完全不同……

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/my-pleasure-43382509]Patreon[/url]]
